title: Scaffold the Nx workspace and factory folders
goal: Create the pnpm + Nx monorepo every later task builds on.
acceptance: `pnpm install` and `pnpm nx graph --file=graph.json` succeed on a fresh clone
Folders `materials/`, `emitters/`, `recipes/`, `products/`, `tools/` exist, each with a README stating its rule from CLAUDE.md
@nx/angular, @nx/nest and @nx/plugin are installed; TypeScript strict mode is on
@nx/enforce-module-boundaries is configured with `type:*` tags and a lint test proves a product importing an emitter fails
`pnpm nx run-many -t lint test build` exits 0
scope: Root config files and the five folders only.

title: Define material.yaml and product.yaml schemas with a validate command
goal: Make materials and products machine-checkable so the factory can trust them.
acceptance: JSON Schemas for material.yaml and product.yaml live in `tools/schemas/` and match the architecture doc
`pnpm factory validate <path>` validates a file and exits non-zero with a readable error on invalid input
Vitest covers one valid and three invalid examples for each schema

title: First material: orders API in TypeSpec emitting OpenAPI
goal: Create the first real raw material and its validation gates.
acceptance: `materials/orders-api/` holds `orders.tsp` (list, get, create order) and a valid material.yaml
`pnpm nx run orders-api:emit-openapi` writes `generated/openapi.yaml`
Spectral lint runs with a ruleset in `tools/spectral/` and passes
oasdiff compares against the last released spec and fails on a breaking change (proved by a test fixture)

title: Emitter: typed Angular client from OpenAPI
goal: Turn an API material into a client Angular products can consume.
acceptance: `emitters/ts-angular-client` is an Nx plugin whose executor implements the Emitter contract from the architecture doc
Running it on orders-api produces an Angular HttpClient-based client with typed models via orval
Output goes to the material's `generated/angular-client/` folder in a `chore(generate):` commit
Re-running with the same input produces byte-identical output (test proves it)

title: Emitter: NestJS DTOs and controller stubs from OpenAPI
goal: Generate the server side of the same contract.
acceptance: `emitters/nest-server` implements the Emitter contract
It generates DTO classes with class-validator decorators and an abstract controller per tag
A sample service that extends the abstract controller compiles
Deterministic output test, as for the Angular emitter

title: Local registry and versioning: Verdaccio plus Changesets
goal: Publish emitted packages so products consume versions, not source.
acceptance: `docker compose up registry` starts Verdaccio on localhost:4873
Changesets is configured; `pnpm factory release orders-api` versions and publishes `@factory/orders-api-angular` and `@factory/orders-api-nest`
A script installs the published package into a temp project to prove it resolves

title: Recipe: nestjs-service skeleton generator
goal: One command creates a golden-path NestJS service.
acceptance: `recipes/nestjs-service` generator creates a service with health endpoint, config validation, OpenTelemetry setup and a `src/ext/` folder
Generated service passes lint, test and build
Generator test snapshots the file tree

title: Recipe: angular-remote skeleton with Native Federation
goal: One command creates a golden-path Angular remote.
acceptance: `recipes/angular-remote` generator creates a standalone Angular remote exposed through Native Federation, with routing and a `src/ext/` folder
Generated remote passes lint, test and build
Generator test snapshots the file tree

title: Assembly CLI: product.yaml to a working product
goal: Connect manifest, resolver, recipe and emitters into one command.
acceptance: `pnpm factory assemble products/orders-ui/product.yaml` resolves material versions from Verdaccio, runs the recipe and installs the emitted packages
Same for `products/orders-service/product.yaml` with the nestjs-service recipe
Both assembled products pass lint, test and build
Re-running assemble is idempotent

title: Gate 1 demo: change the spec, regenerate both sides, contract test catches drift
goal: Prove Gate 1: one product rebuilt entirely from its spec.
acceptance: A contract test runs the Angular client against the NestJS service in CI
`scripts/gate1-demo.sh` adds a field to orders.tsp, releases, re-assembles both products and passes
The same script with a breaking change is stopped by oasdiff before release
PROGRESS.md records Gate 1 evidence and the planner opens a `Gate 1 review` issue for a human
scope: scripts/, products/, CI contract test job.
